deduplication.predecessorRelation: predecessor is the downstream consumer; this wave prepares the prerequisite it is gated on
deduplication.note: First wave of the governed-inference lane. Satisfies the estate prerequisite szl-holdings/a11oy#1806 P1 as a contract; it calls no inference and changes no route.

candidate.title: Governed inference route binding contract v1
candidate.note: No candidate model is named by this wave. A candidate becomes eligible to be named only by presenting evidence satisfying every contract field. Naming a candidate without evidence is a guard failure.

requiredFields.name: modelRevision
requiredFields.rule: Exact immutable model revision (commit SHA or content-addressed artifact hash) from a license-admitted source. A mutable ref (main, latest, a tag alone) is never a binding.

requiredFields.name: tokenizerRevision
requiredFields.rule: Exact tokenizer revision, bound independently of the model revision; a tokenizer that silently floats invalidates the route.

requiredFields.name: benchmarkSuite
requiredFields.rule: Named benchmark set with pinned versions and a committed harness; results land on receipts, not in prose.

requiredFields.name: latencyCostEnvelope
requiredFields.rule: Declared p50/p95/p99 latency bounds and cost-per-token envelope measured on the exact bound revisions; overruns fail closed, never silently degrade.

requiredFields.name: fallbackPolicy
requiredFields.rule: Named fallback disposition for provider failure: abstain, downgrade to a separately bound route, or refuse. 'Try anyway' is not a policy.

requiredFields.name: piiBoundary
requiredFields.rule: Declared PII handling boundary: what may reach the provider, what is redacted, what is refused at the gate.

requiredFields.name: failClosedBehavior
requiredFields.rule: Every failure mode (provider down, revision mismatch, envelope breach, benchmark regression, PII violation) terminates in refusal, never in a weaker silent route.

bindingContract.bindingReceipt: A route is bound only when a DSSE receipt records all seven fields against the exact revisions; the receipt, not the declaration, is the binding.
bindingContract.unbindingRule: Any field that drifts (revision floats, benchmark regresses, envelope breaches persist) unbinds the route automatically and returns the estate to the plan state.

relationToWorkspaceReadout.rule: The workspace readout lane's step 1 (governed-inference-binding) is satisfied by a receipt against this contract. Only then do steps 2-4 of that wave become executable.

relationToBakeoff.rule: Engine-bakeoff candidates (vLLM, SGLang, transformers serve, llama.cpp/MLX lanes) are evaluated behind this contract; the bakeoff measures bound routes, never unbound demos.

claimSurfaces: No route is bound by this wave; this wave defines what binding means.
No inference is called; no model revision, tokenizer, benchmark, envelope, fallback, PII, or fail-closed evidence exists yet.
An unbound plan remains a plan; the estate does not call it inference.
